def factor_vwap_sma_compression_volume_persistence(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy["close"]
    high = df_copy["high"]
    low = df_copy["low"]
    volume = df_copy["volume"]
    prev_close = close.shift(1)
    tr = pd.concat([(high - low),
                    (high - prev_close).abs(),
                    (low - prev_close).abs()], axis=1).max(axis=1)
    norm_tr = tr / close.replace(0, np.nan)
    mean_tr = norm_tr.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    std_tr = norm_tr.rolling(20, min_periods=20).std(ddof=1)
    cv_tr = std_tr / mean_tr.replace(0, np.nan)
    compression = 1.0 / (1.0 + cv_tr)
    vwap = (close * volume).rolling(20, min_periods=20).sum() / volume.rolling(20, min_periods=20).sum().replace(0, np.nan)
    sma = close.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    div = (vwap - sma) / close.replace(0, np.nan)
    med_volume = volume.rolling(20, min_periods=20).median()
    vol_ratio = volume / med_volume.replace(0, np.nan)
    lag_vol_ratio = vol_ratio.shift(1)
    persistence = vol_ratio.rolling(30, min_periods=30).corr(lag_vol_ratio).fillna(0.0)
    weight = 0.5 + 0.5 * np.clip(persistence, -1.0, 1.0)
    factor = div * compression * weight
    df_copy["factor_vwap_sma_compression_volume_persistence"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_vwap_sma_compression_volume_persistence"]

The compression term shrinks the signal when normalized true range CV is high and amplifies it during compressed volatility regimes. Secondary lightweight idea from g1_crossover_alpha_range_vol_gen0_001_avs_gen0_002_0a93015b: volume surprise persistence as a bounded weight using rolling correlation of volume-to-median ratio with its lag. The weight is 0.5 + 0.5*clip(persistence,-1,1), which yields range [0,1]; it reinforces the compressed divergence when volume bursts are persistent (weight approaches 1) and attenuates it fully to zero on strongly anti-persistent days (weight approaches 0). This weight preserves the sign and continuity of the raw signal except at the extreme attenuation boundary.
